scope: offline source/schema conversion; no Ollama inference or installed runtime validation
method: Compiled the pinned C++ converter offline with minimal dependency shims for common.h and ggml.h; converter/parser algorithms were unchanged. Generated schemas from Luci's Go helpers and passed both to the converter.

priorMixedSchema.finding: Both alternatives contained only blocking/question; summary, nextAction, acceptance and priority were absent from generated grammar. The converter ignored sibling properties.

completeBranchSchema.finding: root ::= alternative-0 | alternative-1; both object alternatives include all eight required answer fields and nested proposal rules. The false branch generates question ::= empty string; the true branch generates question ::= quoted char{8,}.

limits: Converter output verifies grammar construction from this pinned source. It does not prove live Ollama generation, model quality or application acceptance.
